name: The Center at Orchard Hill Summer Day Camps
description_short: Nature- and arts-based summer day camps for school-age children, plus teen summer programs and a Counselor in Training program. Days include campfire stories, songs, games, swimming, art and cooking, and children of all abilities are welcome.
special_needs_notes: The page says children of all abilities are welcome, with support from Monadnock Developmental Services. Families of children with a difference or disability who don't have public funding can work with the camp to arrange for their child to attend a week of day camp.
swim_waterfront_notes: The page mentions swimming as a camp activity. It gives no details about the location, supervision or swim tests.
